commitNote: the tagged release v0.3.0: the event kinds, x-<plugin>/<kind> extensions and the contract isEventKind, copied from the release tarball after verifying it against the release SHA256SUMS
note: The records service ships alone (records/Dockerfile copies records/src into the image), so it cannot import the plugin copy at runtime. Only the contract's isEventKind and EVENT_KINDS are used, from the package events module, unchanged: the store kind gate is the contract rule, never a list copied by hand. check:copies and test/source-kinds.test.js hold every file here byte-identical to src/vendor/source-contract, so a vendored bump cannot leave the store behind. Do not edit a file in this directory: a change belongs upstream, or in a new copy of the whole module.
